services.heroSubtitle: I'm Phúc — a final-year software student building websites for small shops, personal brands and people just starting out. You don't need to know anything technical: tell me the goal and I'll handle the rest. You see a working preview before deciding to go further.
services.guaranteesHeading: There's almost no risk on your side

guarantees.title: Free consultation
guarantees.desc: Message me first and we'll pin down exactly what the work covers — no commitment yet.

guarantees.title: Preview before you commit
guarantees.desc: You review a sample design and only move forward once you're happy — no buying blind.

guarantees.title: Support after handover
guarantees.desc: Free bug fixes and small tweaks for 14 days, plus an easy-to-follow usage guide.

services.processHeading: A lean process you can always follow
workingSteps: You send me what you need — an existing site or just the idea. No obligation.
I talk you through the options and suggest the approach that fits.
We agree the scope and timeline, then start; you follow progress step by step.
Full handover, a usage walkthrough, and help with small tweaks afterwards.
services.closingNote: Not sure where to start? Send me your goal or the site you already have and I'll suggest the leanest way forward — even if all you need is one very simple page. Not technical? That's my part to handle. Want more certainty first? Take a look at the work I've already shipped.
services.closingCta: Message me for a free consultation

website.name: Multi-page website
website.description: For small shops, cafés, personal brands or services that need a complete multi-page website (about, services, contact...) to look professional and sell better.
website.note: Scope is set by the pages and features you actually need; you follow progress milestone by milestone.

SEO-ready structure and Google indexing so customers can find you

1 month of free maintenance (4 small edits) after handover

dynamic.name: Website with data management
dynamic.description: When you need more than a brochure site: sign-up / booking forms, member login, a content admin area, or a connection to your existing system or API.
dynamic.note: Projects with automated online payment or complex permissions get broken out part by part before we start.
features: One core flow: online booking OR basic order taking, stored in a database
Management dashboard: view orders/appointments, customers and basic stats
Role-based login for 2 levels: owner and staff
Connect one data source you already use: Google Sheet or Zalo
Full clean source code handed over — the website is your asset
1 month of technical support after handover (fixing new issues)

optimize.name: SEO & speed up an existing site
optimize.description: For a live Next.js/React website that loads slowly, breaks often, looks poor on mobile or can't rank on Google — I clean it up to be leaner, faster and more SEO-ready.
optimize.note: Best for React/Next.js sites or websites that are slow or hard to rank on Google.
features: Speed optimization: compress images, clean up dead code, enable caching
Metadata + rich share images for up to 5 key pages
Google Search Console setup and a complete sitemap
Before–after PageSpeed report with recommended next steps

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: A few common questions before starting a project.

items.title: How is the cost worked out?
items.content: Every project is different, so there's no fixed list. Describe what you need, we agree on a clear scope, and we settle the rest directly — once it's agreed, nothing hidden.

items.title: You're a student — is the work reliable?
items.content: I'm a final-year software student taking on real projects to sharpen my skills. You get a product built with modern tech and clean code, and I give it my all because it's part of my portfolio too. You're welcome to review demos and past work before deciding.

items.title: Can you build a site if I don't have a design?
items.content: Yes. Just describe your idea, your field or your goal. I'll advise on content structure, layout and the right approach.

items.title: Is the website SEO-optimized?
items.content: Yes. Sites are built with a search-friendly structure and support load-speed optimization, metadata, sitemap and the basic technical SEO factors.

items.title: Do you help with domain and hosting?
items.content: Yes. I can advise on or set up domain, hosting and related services if you don't have the infrastructure yet.

items.title: Is there support after handover?
items.content: Yes. After completion I still provide usage guidance, answer questions and handle bug fixes and small tweaks within the agreed scope.
